  • 1 x Beaded Tasbeeh

  • 1 x Toy Camera
  • 1 x Decorative Storage Tin

Key Features:

  • Soft printed prayer mat
  • Includes tasbeeh and counter
  • Decorative gift tin
  • Compact, portable set
